operating_notes.text: Second 4 MTPA pellet plant at Konsari commissioned in 16 months; own pellet capacity now 8 MTPA across two plants, excluding MRPPL and BRPL.
Existing 4 MTPA pellet plant at Konsari has reached 100% capacity utilisation.
Pellet plant feedstock comes from captive low-alumina iron ore mines at Surjagarh, Gadchiroli, via an 85-km slurry pipeline commissioned in June 2025.
Konsari 4 MTPA pellet plant was capitalised at ₹2,236 Cr against a placement-document estimate of ₹1,625 Cr, validated by an independent chartered engineer certificate dated 19 March 2026.
QIP proceeds of ₹1,218 Cr were 99.97% utilised by 31 March 2026, with ₹0.33 Cr left in ICICI Bank accounts.
The company lent ICDs of unutilised issue proceeds to Pune IT Space Solutions in March 2026, whose FY24 balance sheet was ₹63 Cr and turnover ₹9.67 Cr.
Allotted 75,000 NCDs of face value ₹1 Lakh each aggregating to ₹750 Cr at 8% p.a. coupon.
Pellet plant reached 100% capacity utilization within 4 months of commissioning.
Board approved NCD issuance up to ₹3,000 Cr and USD notes up to $130M while cancelling a ₹600 Cr NCD proposal.
Entered into SSSHA and PPA with Amplus Green One, Amplus Energy One, and Amplus Ceres Solar for group captive renewable power.
Approved pricing and terms for USD 130 million senior secured floating rate notes at SOFR + 450 bps maturing on 29 October 2029.
Allotted USD 130M senior secured floating rate notes at 3M Term SOFR + 4.5% margin due 29 October 2029 on private placement under Reg S.
Crisil reaffirmed bank loan facilities at ₹17,112 Cr (enhanced from ₹8,500 Cr) with Crisil AA/Stable and A1+ ratings.

timeline.summary: 2026-04-21: Crisil Ratings assigned/reaffirmed CRISIL AA/Stable on Lloyds Metals' ₹8,500 Cr bank loan facilities and ₹2,500 Cr NCDs.
On April 29, 2026, Lloyds Metals approved issuing Non-Convertible Debentures up to ₹750 crore on a private placement basis.

Lloyds Metals And Energy Ltd schedules Q4FY26 earnings conference call with **Mr. Rajesh Gupta (MD), Mr. Riyaz Shaikh (CFO), Mr. S.K. Naredi (Director Finance), and Mr. Chintan Mehta (CIO)** on **May 6, 2026, at 3:30 PM IST** for investors and analysts.
2026-05-04: Lloyds Metals commissioned its second 4 MTPA pellet plant at Konsari, Maharashtra, in 16 months, taking own pellet capacity to 8 MTPA.
Rajesh Gupta (Promoter) declared no new encumbrance or pledge on Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited shares for FY2026, per SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Lloyds Metals And Energy Limited reported standalone revenue of ₹4,900.71 Cr and PAT of ₹1,065.59 Cr for Q4FY26, and approved a final dividend of Re. 1 per share.

2026-05-05: Monitoring agency report for Q4FY26 said ₹196.61 Cr of QIP proceeds reached promoter Thriveni Earthmovers indirectly via LICL, and flagged the Konsari pellet plant cost overrun to ₹2,236 Cr from ₹1,625 Cr.

Lloyds Metals And Energy Limited hosted Q4 FY26 earnings conference call recording on 06 May 2026 at 15:30 via https://lloyds.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Intimation-of-Earnings-Call-Recording-for-Quarter-and-Year-Ended-31st-March-2026.mp3, confirming no UPSI shared.
On 2026-05-08, Lloyds Metals and Energy allotted ₹750 Cr of unsecured NCDs bearing an 8% coupon due in May 2032.
2026-05-06: Lloyds Metals reported record Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,977 Cr and PAT of ₹1,066 Cr, backed by strong iron ore volume growth.
Lloyds Metals & Energy Ltd’s **Akshay Vora** announced participation in **Nomura Investment Forum Asia 2026** on **June 4, 2026**, in Singapore via physical and virtual modes.
Lloyds Metals approved a ₹3,000 Cr NCD raise and $130M USD notes, cancelling a ₹600 Cr NCD plan.
Mr. Avijit Ghosh (DIN: 03101511) appointed as Non-Executive Independent Director of Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited, effective 24 October 2026.
Lloyds Metals and Energy entered into Share Subscription and Shareholders Agreements and Power Purchase Agreements with Amplus group entities for renewable power on October 27, 2026.
Lloyds Metals approved the pricing and terms for USD 130 million senior secured notes at SOFR + 450 bps due in October 2029.
Allotted USD 130 million senior secured floating rate notes maturing 29 October 2029 at 3M Term SOFR + 4.5%.
Company will hold an earnings conference call on 4 November 2026 at 3:30 p.m. IST for Q2 & H1FY27 results.
Crisil reaffirmed Lloyds Metals' bank facilities of ₹17,112 Cr at AA/Stable and A1+, and assigned ratings to new NCD tranches.
